task1RawMatrixSafety.originalWeakness: geul_flat_hwpx_identity inspected only composed render_* values with abs(v - expected) > 1e-6 (which yields false on NaN), omitted saturating-cast bounds before round() as i32, and did not validate every matrix inside ShapeComponentAttr.raw_rendering.
task1RawMatrixSafety.contract: Every non-empty raw_rendering buffer must match length 2 + 48 + count*96 (count <= 64) with all finite f64 entries; transMatrix linear entries must be exact identity [1,0,tx,0,1,ty] with integer translation in [0, MAX_RECT_DIM_HU] matching either (0,0) or child offset (0,0 for parent); every (scaMatrix, rotMatrix) pair must be exact [1,0,0,0,1,0]; all 6 modeled render_* fields must be finite with exact identity linear components and bounded integer translation matching offset.

task2EllipseGeometrySafety.originalWeakness: geul_group_child_geom_ok used signed i32 subtraction and .abs() <= 1 (which can overflow/wrap to <= 1 on extreme coordinates like i32::MIN + 1) and checked start1 == end1 without verifying canonical full-ellipse endpoint equality to axis1 before resize.
task2EllipseGeometrySafety.contract: All center/axis1/axis2/endpoint checks use overflow-free i64 comparisons with odd-width rounding tolerance [w/2, (w+1)/2] for center only (exact w/h on axis1/axis2) and attr == 0; canonical full ellipses (all four start/end endpoints == axis1) support move and resize, whereas valid-axis ellipses with noncanonical endpoints preserve endpoints on move and refuse resize without silent normalization; extreme/degenerate axes fail closed.

task3ResizePointerCapture.originalState: startResize in src/components/Editor/GroupChildEditor.tsx already called setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId) and wired onPointerCancel/onLostPointerCapture; lacked active-pointer guard against secondary pointer hijack, best-effort try/catch capture/release, preventDefault, and U1-U8 test coverage.
task3ResizePointerCapture.contract: Single active pointer owns drag.current; best-effort setPointerCapture/releasePointerCapture never throw when unsupported; pointerCancel and lostPointerCapture clear preview/drag with zero mutation; pointerUp commits at most one edit; north/west handles remain absent.
